lines.2: We talked while washing the dishes together.
lines.3: Doing them alone was a chore, but doing them together was fun.
lines.4: 「Tell me, why is Date such a good cook?」
lines.5: 「He learned. His mother left home, after all.」
lines.6: 「Is that so? He has had a difficult time.」
lines.7: 「And he doesn't get along with his father.」
lines.9: 「So that is why he prepared meals here... How indulgent.」
lines.11: 「He has a home to return to. Why not work to make life there pleasant? Even if he dislikes his father, could that not simply be adolescent rebellion?」
lines.12: 「You can probably only say that because you were blessed with good parents, Otome.」
lines.13: 「There are plenty of people in this world who simply cannot be helped.」
lines.14: 「Even so, that man is his parent. His own blood.」
lines.16: 「--Let us stop. This is becoming another argument.」
lines.17: 「Yeah. I don't like letting the mood carry me away.」
